Venue: Gate
Headline: Gate Thanksgiving Rewards: Check In, Rank Up, Win Up to 8,000 USDT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Thank you for joining us, and welcome back to those returning. Gate Thanksgiving Rewards is now live. New futures traders and returning users who meet the requirements can claim a 100 USDT Futures Position Trial Voucher. Trade on consecutive days to unlock more vouchers and USDT cash rewards, and compete on the 40,000 USDT trading volume leaderboard for the 8,000 USDT top prize.
Join Now
## Campaign Period: November 25, 2026, 08:00 (UTC) – December 5, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## How to Participate
Log in to Gate, visit the campaign page, and click [Join Now] to register. Then trade the designated USDT-margined perpetual futures during the campaign. New and existing users may participate in the activities for which they qualify. Only valid trades executed after successful registration will count.
## Activity 1: First-Trade Rewards — Claim a 100 USDT Futures Position Trial Voucher
Users trading futures on Gate for the first time can receive a 100 USDT Futures Position Trial Voucher by successfully registering, executing their first futures trade after registration, and reaching 10,000 USDT in cumulative valid futures trading volume.
Rewards are limited to the first 500 eligible users, with one reward per user. Reward eligibility is determined by the time users complete all requirements. New futures traders are users who have never executed a futures trade on Gate. They do not need to be newly registered Gate users.
## Activity 2: Welcome-Back Rewards — Claim a 100 USDT Futures Position Trial Voucher
Users who have previously traded futures on Gate but have executed no futures trades for the 30 consecutive days immediately before the campaign starts can receive a 100 USDT Futures Position Trial Voucher by successfully registering, executing their first futures trade upon returning, and reaching 20,000 USDT in cumulative valid futures trading volume after registration.
Rewards are limited to the first 500 eligible users, with one reward per user. Reward eligibility is determined by the time users complete all requirements. Returning-user eligibility is assessed at the campaign start time for all users. First-trade and welcome-back rewards cannot be combined.
## Activity 3: Keep Trading — Unlock Check-In Rewards
Complete at least 5,000 USDT in valid futures trading volume each day to complete that day's check-in. Check in on consecutive days to receive the following rewards:
Consecutive Check-In Days | Additional Reward for This Tier | Reward Availability
3 days | 20 USDT Futures Position Trial Voucher | First 1,000 eligible users
5 days | 100 USDT Futures Position Trial Voucher | First 1,000 eligible users
7 days | 5 USDT cash reward | First 1,000 eligible users
- Rewards from different tiers can be combined, with one reward per user per tier. Users who qualify for a reward place at all three tiers can receive 120 USDT in Futures Position Trial Vouchers and 5 USDT in cash.
- Each task period runs from 08:00 (UTC) to 08:00 (UTC) the following day, with 10 task periods in total. The period in which a user registers can count as their first check-in day if their trading volume after registration meets the requirement. Trading volume is calculated separately for each period and does not carry over to the next period.
- If a user fails to meet the requirement in any period, their consecutive-day count resets. Previously received tier rewards will not be issued again.
- Reward eligibility is determined separately for each tier by the time users meet that tier's requirements. All requirements must be completed before the campaign ends.
- This activity is open to all eligible registered participants, including existing users who have continued trading actively.
## Activity 4: Climb the Leaderboard — Compete for 40,000 USDT
Registered users who reach 50,000 USDT in cumulative valid futures trading volume during the campaign can participate in the trading volume leaderboard. After the campaign ends, the top 100 users who also meet the minimum trading volume requirement for their ranking tier can receive the corresponding rewards:
Rank | Reward | Minimum Cumulative Valid Futures Trading Volume
1st | 8,000 USDT | 50,000,000 USDT
2nd | 5,000 USDT | 30,000,000 USDT
3rd | 3,000 USDT | 20,000,000 USDT
4th–10th | 1,000 USDT per user | 5,000,000 USDT
11th–30th | 350 USDT per user | 1,000,000 USDT
31st–100th | Share 10,000 USDT in proportion to trading volume, capped at 300 USDT per user | 50,000 USDT
## Ranking and Reward Rules
- Users are ranked from highest to lowest by cumulative valid futures trading volume during the campaign. If trading volumes are equal, the user who reached that volume earlier ranks higher.
- Users must meet both the ranking requirement and the minimum trading volume requirement for their ranking tier. Users who do not meet the minimum requirement will not receive that tier's reward or be moved to another reward tier.
- Reward per Eligible User Ranked 31st–100th = Individual Cumulative Valid Futures Trading Volume / Total Cumulative Valid Futures Trading Volume of All Eligible Users in That Tier × 10,000 USDT, capped at 300 USDT per user.
- Rewards left undistributed because of unmet requirements, unfilled positions, or individual reward caps will not pass to other users or be redistributed.
## Terms and Conditions
- Users must successfully register on the campaign page before participating. Only genuine, valid trades executed after registration and during the campaign in the designated USDT-margined perpetual futures will count. The eligible trading scope is subject to the campaign page.
- Valid trading volume is calculated as the sum of the actual executed value of buy and sell trades. Unfilled orders, the unfilled portions of canceled orders, and trades deemed abnormal by Gate do not count toward tasks or the leaderboard.
- First-trade and welcome-back rewards cannot be combined. Eligible users may receive one of these rewards alongside check-in and leaderboard rewards. The same valid trade may count toward the applicable tasks and leaderboard. Daily check-in volume is calculated separately for each day. Cumulative trading tasks and the leaderboard count volume throughout the campaign.
- Activities 1 and 2 are each limited to the first 500 eligible users. Each tier of Activity 3 is limited to the first 1,000 eligible users. Places are awarded in the order users complete all applicable requirements, with one reward per user per activity or tier.
- All rewards will be distributed within 14 business days after the campaign ends, following verification of valid trading activity and user eligibility. Eligible markets, usage requirements, validity periods, and treatment of profits for Futures Position Trial Vouchers are subject to the instructions on the vouchers and the voucher page. Voucher face values do not represent cash that can be withdrawn directly.
- Each user may participate with only one eligible main account. Users must complete the identity verification required by Gate and meet the applicable product access and reward eligibility requirements before receiving rewards.
- Updates to task and leaderboard data may be delayed. Final valid trading volumes, rankings, and reward eligibility are subject to Gate's verified results.
- Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
- Users must comply with the Gate User Agreement, futures product terms, and applicable requirements in their jurisdiction. Users in certain regions may be unable to participate, depending on Gate's actual service availability.
- Futures trading involves the risk of losses and liquidation. This campaign does not constitute investment advice or a guarantee of returns. Please make sure you understand the product rules and participate according to your risk tolerance.
- If the campaign period, rules, or rewards need to be adjusted due to market changes, system issues, compliance requirements, or force majeure, Gate will announce the relevant arrangements on the campaign page. Gate reserves the right to interpret the campaign rules to the extent permitted by applicable law.

Headline: Futures Check-In AI Power Edition: Share 500,000 USDT and Unlock Extra NVDAG Rewards

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Futures Check-In AI Power Edition is now live. Complete the daily check-in task to unlock a 10 USDT reward. Friend referral reward is also available, with a total prize pool of 500,000 USDT up for grabs. Active users will also have a chance to win a share of the $5,000 NVDAG prize pool. Keep checking in to unlock more rewards.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 25, 2026, 08:00 – December 9, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## Rules
Check-In Period: Each check-in day runs from 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 (UTC).
Prize Pool: Events 1 and 2 share a total prize pool of 500,000 USDT. Users can earn rewards by completing the corresponding tasks. Rewards will be credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis. Events 1 and 2 will automatically end once the prize pool is fully distributed. Event 3 has a $5,000 NVDAG prize pool, which will be distributed within 14 business days after the event ends.
## Event 1: Meet Daily Targets — Check In to Claim 10 USDT
During the event, users who reach a daily futures trading volume of ≥ $5,000 (any trading pair) will qualify for a successful check-in. Each successful daily check-in rewards 10 USDT, credited automatically. Total prize pool: 450,000 USDT.
## Event 2: Rally Your Friends — Invite Friends to Earn 10 USDT
During the event, invite friends to sign up. When a referee achieves a futures trading volume of at least 1,000 USDT, the referral will be considered successful. Earn 10 USDT for each successful referral. Rewards are credited automatically. Total prize pool: 50,000 USDT.
## Event 3: AI Power Challenge — Stack Perks for $5,000 NVDAG
Active users who complete ≥ 10 days of check-ins under Event 1 and achieve a cumulative futures trading volume of ≥ $1,000,000 during the event will have a chance to receive a check-in reward package after the event ends. Winners will be randomly selected. The check-in reward packages for this event are as follows. Each user may receive only one reward package:
Reward Package | Slots
$100 in NVDAG | 5
$50 in NVDAG | 20
$20 in NVDAG | 100
$10 in NVDAG | 150
## Notes
- To be eligible for rewards, all participants must click [Join Now] to register and complete identity verification before the event ends.
- Trading Volume = Buy Volume + Sell Volume. During the USD1 futures trading pair fee discount promotion, futures trading volume for the relevant promotional pairs will be calculated at 50%.
- During the event, API trading volume will count toward the event's trading volume calculations, while trading volume generated by trading bots will be excluded. Trading volume generated by copy trading sub-accounts will be aggregated into their respective parent accounts: volume from copy trading sub-accounts under a main account will be attributed to the main account, while volume from those under a regular sub-account will only be attributed to that regular sub-account and will not be aggregated into the main account.
- USDT rewards from Events 1 and 2 will be distributed as Futures Position Vouchers. Rewards will be credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis. Events 1 and 2 will automatically end once the prize pool is fully distributed. NVDAG rewards from Event 3 will be distributed as spot tokens and credited to users' accounts within 14 business days after the event ends.
- Gate will review account activity, transactions, and fund transfers during the event. Violations include participating repeatedly through multiple accounts, identity impersonation or submission of false verification information, wash trading or matched trading, circular transfers of on-chain funds, coordinated reward abuse, repeated fund transfers, and any other activities that compromise the fairness of the event. Gate reserves the right to disqualify users found to have engaged in such violations from receiving rewards.
- Market makers, corporate, institutional accounts are not eligible for this event.
- In the event of any discrepancy between the translated version and the English version, the English version shall prevail.
- Gate reserves the right of final interpretation for this event.
- Users in the UK and other restricted regions may be unable to access some or all services (including participation in this event, game, or competition). For details on restricted regions, please refer to the User Agreement . Please note that we do not intend to solicit or market to users in these restricted regions.

Headline: Trenches Base Chain Limited-Time Rewards: Share 30,000 USDT in Triple Rewards

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
The Trenches Base Chain Limited-Time Rewards campaign is now live. During the campaign, trade Base chain tokens in the Trenches zone to unlock three rewards: Returning User Exclusive, Daily Trading Rewards, and Trading Sprint. Share a total prize pool of 30,000 USDT. All three rewards can be claimed together.
Click "Join Now" to register first, then trade Base chain tokens in the Trenches zone to become eligible for rewards.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 25, 2026, 10:00 – December 1, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## Event Scope
All Base chain tokens in the Trenches zone. Both buy and sell trades count toward trading volume.
## Reward 1: 10 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher for Returning Users
Returning users who trade Base chain tokens in the Trenches zone during the campaign and reach a cumulative trading volume (buy and sell combined) of 100 USDT will receive a 10 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher. Total pool: 10,000 USDT. Limited to 1 voucher per user, distributed in order of qualification, while supplies last.
This reward is exclusive to returning users. Returning users are those who have previously traded on Gate Trenches (including the former Gate Alpha) and have not traded on Trenches in the 7 days before the campaign starts. Returning users may also participate in Rewards 2 and 3.
## Reward 2: Trade Daily, Get a 2 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher Every Day
During the campaign, registered users who trade Base chain tokens in the Trenches zone and reach a daily trading volume (buy and sell combined) of 400 USDT will receive a 2 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher for that day. Each user can receive this reward up to once per day. Total pool: 10,000 USDT. Rewards are distributed automatically on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
## Reward 3: Trading Sprint, Share 10,000 USDT
During the campaign, registered users who trade Base chain tokens in the Trenches zone and reach a cumulative trading volume (buy and sell combined) of 1,000 USDT can share a 10,000 USDT prize pool. Rewards are distributed based on each user's share of the total trading volume of all qualified users, capped at 20 USDT per user.
## Notice
Users must complete identity verification to claim rewards.
Only trading volume generated after successful registration and during the campaign period will be counted. Trades made before registration do not count. Trading volume that does not meet the daily threshold still counts toward cumulative trading volume.
Reward 2 is calculated based on calendar days in UTC+0. Users can claim it on any day they meet the threshold, and consecutive trading is not required.
Rewards from this campaign cannot be combined with other campaigns, and rewards from campaigns of the same type cannot be stacked.
Please verify the token name, chain, and contract address before trading. If any token information is incorrect, please contact customer support.
Campaign page data will be updated within 1–2 hours. Displayed data and estimated rewards are for reference only, and final results will be calculated according to the campaign rules. Airdrop rewards will be distributed as Trenches token mystery boxes. Token prices may fluctuate, and the actual amount received shall prevail.
Fee Rebate Vouchers will be distributed automatically. Airdrop rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the campaign ends.
Fee Rebate Vouchers must be activated before use and cannot be withdrawn or transferred. Applicable markets, rebate ratios, and validity periods are subject to the voucher details.
First-time Trenches users must follow the on-page instructions to accept the innovation trading disclaimer and relevant user agreements. Token projects may carry significant risks and price volatility. Please participate with caution.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person's identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
In case of any discrepancy between different language versions, the English version shall prevail.
Gate reserves the right of final interpretation of this campaign and may adjust the terms or cancel the campaign without prior notice.
Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions are not eligible to participate. For details, please refer to the User Agreement. This campaign is not intended to solicit or market to users in restricted regions.

🔥 Turn on Futures Auto-Earn and let your idle margin earn yield automatically! Double rewards, up to $60!
🎁 New User Exclusive: First-time activation of Futures Auto-Earn – get $10 free!
📈 Deposit Challenge: The more you net deposit, the higher the rewards – up to $50!
⏰ Event Period: 08:00, November 25, 2026 – 08:00, December 8, 2026 (UTC)
## 🎁 Event 1: First-Time Activation of Futures Auto-Earn – Get $10 Free!
During the event, successfully activate Futures Auto-Earn for the first time and complete a net transfer of ≥ 50 USDT into Futures, to receive 10 USDT Futures Trial Fund for free! Limited to 1,000 spots – first come, first served!
Eligibility: Users who have never activated Futures Auto-Earn before the event starts.
How to Activate: XT App → Assets → Futures → Enable Futures Auto-Earn
## 🎁 Event 2: Deposit Challenge – Win Up to $50 in Rewards!
During the event, activate Futures Auto-Earn and keep it enabled until the end of the event. Rewards will be distributed based on your net deposit amount during the event period:
Net Deposit Amount | Reward
≥ 100 USDT | 5 USDT Trial Fund
≥ 500 USDT | 10 USDT Trial Fund
≥ 1,000 USDT | 20 USDT Trial Fund
≥ 5,000 USDT | 50 USDT Trial Fund
## Participation & Reward Rules:
Event 1 is only available to users who have never activated Futures Auto-Earn before the event starts.
Event 1 and Event 2 can be participated in simultaneously, and rewards can be claimed for both.
For Event 2, only the highest applicable reward tier will be granted.
## Terms & Conditions
Eligibility: Users must click “Join Now” on the event page to register in order to qualify for rewards.
Subaccounts, market makers, channel users, brokers, and institutional accounts are not eligible to participate.
Net Deposit & Retention: Net Deposit = Valid external deposits during the event period − External withdrawals. Deposit currencies are not limited to the event tokens. Internal transfers within the platform are not counted as deposits. Trading profits and losses are not counted as deposits or withdrawals. Non-USDT assets will be converted based on the platform’s reference price at the time of deposit or withdrawal.
Reward Distribution: After meeting the requirements and passing risk control review, rewards will be distributed within 7 working days after the event ends. The actual status is subject to the event page and account records.
Futures Trial Fund: Users can view it in “Personal Center” or “Rewards Center” → “My Vouchers”. The Futures Trial Fund itself is non-withdrawable. Its usage scope, validity period, and specific rules are subject to the voucher page.
Fair Participation: Any form of abnormal volume inflation, self-trading, multi-account arbitrage, or other fraudulent activities is strictly prohibited. Data generated from such behavior will not be counted toward the event. XT.COM reserves the right to disqualify related accounts and reclaim rewards.
Final Interpretation: XT.COM reserves the final right of interpretation for this event.
⚠️ Risk Reminder: Digital asset prices are highly volatile, and futures trading carries significant risk. Please participate rationally based on your own risk tolerance.

Join Now

Visit the event page, connect your wallet, and register for the event.
Go to Gate Perp DEX and trade any perpetual futures trading pair.
Complete the designated trading tasks for a chance to earn corresponding rewards.

Kick-start your on-chain trading journey this Black Friday. Cumulative Eligible Trading Volume | Reward | Reward Quota

Enjoy lower trading costs this Black Friday. During the event, users who trade any perpetual futures on Gate Perp DEX and reach the designated cumulative eligible trading volume thresholds can enjoy corresponding trading fee cashback rates. The more you trade, the higher your cashback rate.
Cumulative Eligible Trading Volume | Trading Fee Cashback Rate | Maximum Cashback per User
≥ 10,000 USDT | 20% | 10 USDT
≥ 50,000 USDT | 30% | 20 USDT
≥ 100,000 USDT | 40% | 50 USDT
≥ 300,000 USDT | 50% | 100 USDT

Trade for 5 days | ≥ 5,000 USDT | 5 USDT | 100
Trade for 7 days | ≥ 10,000 USDT | 20 USDT | 25
Trading days do not need to be consecutive. Rewards will be distributed based on the highest tier achieved, cannot be combined across tiers, and are available on a first-come, first-served basis.
## Terms and Conditions
Users must register on the event page to participate. Trading volume and trading fees incurred before registration will not count toward the event.
Only eligible perpetual futures trading volume on Gate Perp DEX will count toward the event. API trades are excluded.
New users are defined as users who have never traded perpetual futures on Gate Perp DEX before the start of the event.
Trading fee cashback will be calculated based on the actual eligible net trading fees paid by users, excluding any amounts reduced or offset through other rebates, trading fee deductions, or promotional benefits.
Users may earn rewards from multiple sub-events simultaneously. However, rewards from different tiers within the same sub-event cannot be combined. The total rewards earned by each user cannot exceed 80% of the actual eligible net trading fees paid during the event.
The total prize pool is fixed, and rewards are limited. Rewards will be distributed in the order in which users meet the eligibility requirements, on a first-come, first-served basis, while supplies last.
All event rewards will be distributed in the form of Gate Web3 Futures Trial Funds and are expected to be distributed within 7–14 business days after the event ends.
Gate will review account activity, transactions, and fund transfers during the event. Violations include participating repeatedly through multiple accounts, identity impersonation or submission of false verification information, wash trading or matched trading, circular transfers of on-chain funds, coordinated reward abuse, repeated fund transfers, and any other activities that compromise the fairness of the event. Gate reserves the right to disqualify users found to have engaged in such violations from receiving rewards.
Institutional users, market makers, affiliate accounts, and sub-accounts are not eligible to participate in this event.
Gate Web3 reserves the right to modify and provide the final interpretation of this event to the extent permitted by applicable laws.
